title: Qualification and claims discipline
summary: Current validation includes source/prebuilt/runtime-only gates, threading, i8/u8, ABI-native aliases, managed struct graph, PTY/errno, Python proxy/indexing, NumPy zero-copy/reverse import, tensor descriptors/DLPack/device v2 and optional OpenSSL/FFmpeg. Vulkan hardware is SKIP unless a qualifying non-CPU Intel device is present.
invariants: A synthetic device descriptor proves rejection/coordination semantics, not GPU execution.
Optional hardware SKIP must not be reported as PASS.
